config.script:
selectedRowData = self.parent.parent.getChild("TabContainer").getChild("Table_0").props.selection.data[0]
	qualityID = selectedRowData.QualityRecordID
	
	removeQuery = '''update QACheckData set active = 0 where QualityRecordID = ?'''
	args = [qualityID]
	system.db.runPrepUpdate(removeQuery, args, database = 'NLSTWDYK_DB_PROD')
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage('refreshQuality')
	self.props.value = 0

data = {}
	selectedTableData = self.parent.parent.getChild("TabContainer").getChild("Table_0").props.selection.data[0]
	qualityID = selectedTableData.QualityRecordID
	
	data['testResults'] = system.util.jsonDecode(selectedTableData.Results)
	data['LineID'] = selectedTableData.LineID
	data['Article'] = selectedTableData.ArticleID
	data['ArticleDescription'] = selectedTableData.ArticleDescription
	data['TimeOnTube'] = system.date.format(system.date.fromMillis(selectedTableData.TimeOnTube), 'HH:mm:ss')
	data['ProductionDate'] = selectedTableData.ProductionDate
	
	system.perspective.print(data)
	system.perspective.openDock('QualityDock', params = {'newEntry': False, 'edit': True, 'data': data, 'qualityID': qualityID})
